name: Default
server: llama.cpp (llama-server), and any other OpenAI- or Anthropic-compatible server
models: Any model that sees the page and can be made to call a tool
notes: Designed for Qwen 3 models running in llama.cpp (Qwen 3.6 27B and Qwen 3.8 27B), and right for most models. The model must be able to see a picture of the page and be made to answer with a tool call: one that cannot will misread pages or fail jobs. Every call carries the full job description and every tool, and a job takes one call for its plan and one more for each step. On a strong model that uses several times the tokens Lean Default does.
